2. WCAG 2.2 Level A & AA + Revised Section 508 Conformance Matrix

Compile-Time & Runtime Conformance Criteria Evaluated for ADA Title II & Accessible Digital Services
Criterion (WCAG 2.2 / 508) Level Conformance Level Remarks and Explanations
1.1.1 Non-text Content A Supports Compile-time gate (RST014) enforces descriptive alt attributes or explicit role="presentation" decorative flags on every slide graphic.
1.2.2 Captions (Prerecorded) A Supports Compile-time gate (RST010 / RST011) verified 3 synchronized WebVTT caption cues (≤ 25 chars/sec) plus an interactive synchronized transcript drawer.
1.2.5 Audio Description / Media Alternative AA Not Applicable (HTML5-First Audio Course) Course eliminates monolithic video bloat using 1 native semantic HTML5 slide(s) synchronized to lightweight voiceover audio and 3 verified WebVTT cues.
1.3.1 Info and Relationships A Supports Learner runtime renders genuine semantic HTML5 landmarks (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <aside>, <footer>) and <fieldset>/<legend> knowledge checks.
1.4.2 Audio Control A Supports Autoplay is disabled by default; learners have full keyboard-accessible Play/Pause, 5-second Rewind, and interactive transcript cue selection.
1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) AA Supports Verified 8.98:1 button contrast plus automatic Light Mode, Dark Mode (prefers-color-scheme), and Windows Contrast Theme (forced-colors: active) tokens.
1.4.10 Reflow (400% Zoom) AA Supports CSS Grid workspace collapses cleanly into a single vertical column below 1080px / 320px CSS viewport width with zero clipped controls.
2.1.1 Keyboard & 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap A Supports 100% of slide navigation, native <input type="range"> compliance scrubbing, transcript cues, quizzes, and attestations operate via standard keyboard navigation.
2.4.7 Focus Visible & 2.4.11 Focus Appearance AA Supports Dual-ring :focus-visible indicators maintain high contrast across Light, Dark, and Windows High-Contrast surfaces.
2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) AA Supports Interactive buttons, slide navigation steps, and quiz radio/checkbox rows meet or exceed 44×44px (`2.75rem`) hit targets.
3.1.1 Language of Page & 3.1.2 Language of Parts A / AA Supports Document root declares lang="en-US" and every slide card emits its verified BCP 47 lang attribute.
4.1.3 Status Messages AA Supports Live LMS checkpoint state (Progress Saved vs. Offline — Retrying Commit), slide transitions, and quiz grading announce politely via role="status" / aria-live="polite".
